faq.title: Frequently asked questions

items.a: We provide cleaning services in Paphos, Limassol and surrounding areas. Send us the address and we will confirm whether we can travel to your location.

items.q: Do I need to provide cleaning products?
items.a: No. Our team arrives with the necessary professional cleaning products and equipment. If you have allergies or specific product preferences, please let us know when making your booking.

items.q: How long does the cleaning take?
items.a: The duration depends on the size and condition of the property and the selected service. Once we receive your request, we will confirm the details and give you an approximate time estimate.
Yes. We can arrange regular cleaning weekly, every two weeks or on a custom schedule.

items.q: Do you clean Airbnb properties and short-term rentals?
items.a: Yes. We provide cleaning for Airbnb and vacation-rental properties, including preparing the accommodation for the arrival of the next guests.

The price depends on the type of cleaning, the size of the property, the number of rooms and the overall condition of the space. Prices shown on the website are starting prices, and we confirm the final cost after clarifying the details.

items.q: Can I book only oven, refrigerator or window cleaning?
items.a: Yes. Individual specialist services can be booked without a full property cleaning.
Complete the short form or send us a request through WhatsApp. We will contact you, clarify the details and confirm the booking.
Yes. Blue Wave Cleaning provides office and commercial cleaning in Paphos, Limassol and surrounding areas. One-off or regular cleaning can be arranged depending on the needs of your business.

items.q: Do you offer move-in / move-out cleaning?
items.a: Yes. We provide cleaning before move-in and after move-out. The service is suitable for apartments, houses and rental properties that need to be prepared for a move or handed over to the next occupants.

Yes. We provide post-renovation cleaning for apartments, houses and other properties. The scope of work depends on the size and condition of the property, so we confirm the final cost after clarifying the details.

privacyText: We collect the information you choose to send through our booking or contact channels so we can respond to your enquiry and arrange services.
We do not sell personal information. Information may be shared only with service providers needed to operate communications or the website, subject to appropriate safeguards.
You may contact us to ask about, correct or request deletion of personal information we hold, subject to applicable obligations.
cookiesText: This website may use essential browser storage to remember language preferences and whether the short opening animation has already been shown.
Essential storage supports basic website functionality. Analytics or marketing cookies should not be added without updating this policy and, where required, requesting consent.
termsText: A booking form submission is a request, not an automatic confirmation. A service is arranged only after Blue Wave Cleaning confirms availability, scope and price.
Guide prices may change according to property size, condition, access and the agreed scope of work. Any material changes should be agreed before service begins.
Specific access, product, cancellation and other change arrangements should be confirmed directly when the booking is accepted.
